resources.string: Debug evaluation only. Start a run, then use Open as an evaluation page. Explicitly choosing Save or Record from that page begins its test. Ordinary page opens are not included.
Provider counts overlap and cannot be added. Preview shows only the first 32 providers; the sealed export includes all.
Choose a new empty local document. Provider sync is outside this app; failures or cancellation may leave an empty or partial file. Provider source mapping stays in this preview.
Export unavailable: end the current run and refresh its preview first.
③ evaluation supports BASIC recording only. Segment recording is untested. Open an evaluation candidate, then explicitly choose Record. Only verified committed output counts as success.
